title: I-Scout eneentsiba
intro: Ngaphakathi kobukumkani obulawulwa ngumntu onikwe igunya phezu kwemimoya, izidalwa ezingabonakaliyo, kunye nezidalwa zezulu, ilungu elinye elincinci nelikhawulezayo lanyamalala kwizikhundla - laza labuya nezityhilelo ezaziza kuyila ngokutsha ikamva lesizwe esikude. Lo mntu unolwazi olubukhali wazisa inyaniso ekukhanyeni apho ukungazi kwaqala khona. Ndingubani?
clues: Ndikhonze enkundleni apho abantu, izidalwa ezingabonakaliyo, nezidalwa zezulu zazisabela kumlawuli omnye osisilumko owayelawula imimoya.
Bendingekho kwisikhundla sam okwethutyana, kwaye ingqumbo yomlawuli yathenjiswa ukuba ndingaphumeleli ukunika isizathu esaneleyo.
Ndisisidalwa esincinci esibhabhayo, esaziwa ngokubona okubukhali, kwaye uhlobo lwam luhlonitshwe ngokubizwa ngamagama ngokuthe ngqo kumaphepha esityhilelo.
Ndathi ndakubuya, ndabazisa iindaba zelizwe elikude apho abantu babeguqa khona elangeni, bengaboni nto kuLowo wadala amazulu nomhlaba.
Ndifumene umfazi elawula ubukumkani obukhulu, ehleli etroneni ezukileyo, engazange ayazi inyaniso ngaphambili.
Ndingulowo wafumanisa ubukumkani baseSaba' waza waphatha ileta yesimemo esivela kumprofeti-kumkani owanikwa ulawulo phezu komoya.
arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verse: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (27:27)
